ardot-mobile-app-multi-screen v1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Enables production of multiple mobile app screens (e.g. Home/List/Detail/Edit/Integration) on Ardot canvas in one go.
- Designed to unify multi-screen styles and streamline app prototyping workflows.
- Multilingual support for 8 core languages: zh-CN, en, ja, ko, es, fr, de, ar.
- Incorporates SynomosAI governance, AI Passport Regime, and advanced agent identity/tracing principles.
- Provided under MIT license.
